messages:
sam: Quick sync 22:00-02:00 UTC quiet window tonight. Cross-service change touching API/runtime/console/router. Need owners + rollback playbooks in thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled for 22:00 UTC. Runbooks RB-421 + RB-422 attached. Please ack.

chen: I'll own runtime. Pinning image rwinference:2.4.0-canary, start at 2-3% traffic. Enabling KV eviction logs and extra tracing.

julie: API owner. Schema tweak for /v1/generate behind feature-flag target=api-canary. Console team will use backcompat gate.

maria: Router owner. I'll run header-split shadow then 1%->5%->20% ramp. Will not promote until runtime canary green.

sam: Rollout order: runtime canary -> router shadow -> api flag canary -> console gate last. Rollback triggers: p95>2000ms for 5m, 5xx +5ppt, KV miss spike >20%.

chen: Runtime rollback command:```bash
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.8 --immediate --reason "canary regression"
```

julie: API rollback is flip feature flag back to previous and remove canary route. I'll paste curl when we start.

maria: Router rollback snippet:```bash
rtrctl set --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --reason "rollback"
```

ops-oncall: I'll create #ephemeral/deploy-1762477777, hook p95/5xx/KV-miss alerts and page on Sev2. 15min post-100% watch.

deploy-bot: Preflight green: infra ok, images present, console build v8.1-backcompat available.

sam: All owners acked. We'll kick at 22:05 UTC to allow final staging. If thresholds hit, call rollback and ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot. Thanks :thumbsup:
